scenarios.name: Login with valid credentials
scenarios.expected: Navigates to dashboard with active tenant session

scenarios.name: Login with invalid credentials
scenarios.expected: Displays safe error banner without leaking system internals

scenarios.name: Navigate dashboard shell
scenarios.expected: All shell navigation links, metrics, and tables render

scenarios.name: Upload valid PDF file
scenarios.expected: Document registered in list with pending status

scenarios.name: Upload unsupported file
scenarios.expected: Modal displays format error and rejects submission

scenarios.name: Track processing progress
scenarios.expected: Status badge transitions from pending to indexing to ready

scenarios.name: Open extracted document
scenarios.expected: Extracted text chunks, page count, and layout render

scenarios.name: Search document full-text
scenarios.expected: Relevant chunk text highlights and matching scores appear

scenarios.name: Ask question on evidence explorer
scenarios.expected: Generates grounded answer and citation links

scenarios.name: Open citation evidence drawer
scenarios.expected: Evidence drawer highlights exact quote, page, and bbox

scenarios.name: View cross-document conflicts
scenarios.expected: Contradictions between 2 documents surfaced in diff cards

scenarios.name: Download synthesized report
scenarios.expected: Browser initiates valid Markdown/HTML file download

scenarios.name: Delete document cascading
scenarios.expected: Deletes all artifacts; document becomes inaccessible

scenarios.name: Sign out and clear session
scenarios.expected: Tokens purged from storage; redirect to login

scenarios.name: Access restricted page
scenarios.expected: Role authorization guard denies access with 403 notice

scenarios.name: Expired session recovery
scenarios.expected: Prompts user to re-authenticate; preserves in-flight draft
